nodes.text: coder 0 (office-report-builder 0): Workbook writer — sole writer of Afrobeat_Tracklist.xlsx. Create it exactly once with exactly two sheets: Tracklist with columns Track_Number, Song_Title, Artist, Start_Time_Sec, Duration_Sec, Notes and every frozen row (at least twelve, sequential numbering, literal timings); Artist_Summary with columns Artist, Song_Count, Total_Duration_Sec and the frozen artist rows (at least four). Write literal values only, read both populated ranges back, and return path, sheet order, row counts and equality controls.

coder 1 (office-report-builder 1): Document writer — sole writer of Curator_Notes.docx. Create it exactly once with the level-1 heading Afrobeat Mix 2024 - Curator Notes, a Summary section stating the frozen total track count, unique-artist count, and total mix duration estimate, a Notable Tracks section covering the five frozen standout songs with their one-line justifications, and a Genre Analysis section with the two frozen style observations; read the document back and return title, section order and content controls.

coder 2 (external-workflow-operator 0): Wiki writer — sole owner of the Notion page. Search the exact title Afrobeat Mix 2024 Tracklist first; create or complete exactly one nonduplicate page containing every frozen tracklist row (track number, song title, artist) as content blocks plus the complete artist summary, and retrieve its title/body; never retry an ambiguous create.
